patches_modified.name: Clone
patches_modified.description:
Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched app alongside the original Instagram app.
Caution: Do not select the official Morphe's "Change package name" universal patch.

patches_modified.name: Disable Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.

patches_modified.name: Disable story auto flipping
patches_modified.description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Disable video autoplay from feed

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Hides Instants from DMs page.

patches_modified.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches_modified.name: Hide all stories
patches_modified.description:
Hides all stories from the tray in the feed page.
You may need to clean app data after the initial use of this patch to see its effects.

patches_modified.name: Hide explore feed
patches_modified.description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed content
patches_modified.description: Hide the feed content, leaving only stories in the home page.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button. Choose what button to hide using the patch options.

patches_modified.name: Hide notes tray
patches_modified.description: Hides the notes tray from the direct tab.

patches_modified.name: Hide reshare button
patches_modified.description: Hides the reshare button from both posts and reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested content
patches_modified.description: Choose the suggested content to hide using the patch options.

patches_modified.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches_modified.description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.

patches_removed.name: Experimental Native Reconstruction CPU Optimized 8/10-bit
patches_removed.description: 5002322-only permission-free A/B. Auto-matches uniform sRGB8 or RGB10_A2 Valve sources and tries density-preserving, panel-native, then runtime-maximum output sizes.

patches_removed.name: Experimental Native Single Projection Renderer Hook
patches_removed.description: 5002322-only permission-free A/B. Routes Valve's streaming xrEndFrame through an exact-build native helper and tries density-preserving, panel-native, then runtime-maximum output sizes.

patches_removed.name: Experimental Single Projection Reconstruction Efficient
patches_removed.description: 5002322-only permission-free experiment. Reconstructs one stereo projection and tries density-preserving, Galaxy XR panel-native, then runtime-maximum output sizes with guarded fallback.

patches_modified.name: Appear on top
patches_modified.description: Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and the compositor signal window; build 5002322 also gets passive pass-through telemetry and shell-protected surface controls.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Disables SoundCloud's analytics.

patches_modified.name: Disable consent popup
patches_modified.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.

patches_modified.name: Enable SoundCloud Go+
patches_modified.description: Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.

patches_modified.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches_modified.description: Applies Android 12+ Material You dynamic accent colors from the system wallpaper palette.
